stem: The person ____ helped us find the way was very gentle.
expl: who 引导定语从句,先行词 the person 指人,who 在从句中作主语。which 只能指物,what 不能引导定语从句。

stem: Do you know the fighter ____ saved the little girl?
expl: 先行词 the fighter 指人,故用 who 引导定语从句并在从句中作主语。

stem: He is the presenter ____ we saw on TV last night.
expl: 先行词 the presenter 指人,关系词在从句中作 saw 的宾语,故用 who 的宾格形式 whom。

stem: The survivor ____ told the story is my great-aunt.
expl: 先行词 the survivor 指人,who 在从句中作主语,引导定语从句修饰 survivor。

stem: We thanked the doctors ____ worked on the front line.
expl: 先行词 the doctors 指人,用 who 引导定语从句;which 只用于指物。

stem: I still remember the teacher ____ made me love science.
expl: 先行词 the teacher 指人,故用 who;从句 made me love science 说明是哪一位老师。

stem: The dreamer ____ fed countless people is remembered by us all.
expl: 先行词 the dreamer 指人,who 在从句中作主语。

stem: The boy who ____ standing by the engine is my cousin.
expl: 定语从句的谓语要与先行词的数一致:先行词 the boy 是单数,故用 is。

stem: The people who ____ on the front line are true heroes.
expl: 先行词 the people 是复数概念,定语从句谓语用复数形式 work。

stem: The person whom we ____ yesterday is a co-pilot.
expl: 定语从句由时间状语 yesterday 决定用一般过去时 met;whom 在从句中作 met 的宾语。

stem: My great-aunt is the person ____ I want to thank most.
expl: 先行词 the person 指人,关系词在从句中作 thank 的宾语,故用 whom。

stem: Anyone ____ wants to help with the experiment can join us.
expl: 不定代词 anyone 指人,用 who 引导定语从句;从句谓语 wants 与 anyone 的单数一致。

stem: Which sentence has an ATTRIBUTIVE CLAUSE (定语从句)?
opts: The girl who won the race is my sister.
I know who won the race.
Please tell me who won the race.
expl: 定语从句的 who 前面有先行词,用来修饰该名词;A 项中 who won the race 修饰 the girl。B、D 两项的 who 引导宾语从句,作 know / tell 的宾语,前面没有先行词;C 项是疑问句。

stem: She is one of the few people who ____ the whole story.
expl: 定语从句修饰的先行词是 people(复数),故谓语用 know;不要被前面的 one of 误导为单数。

opts: This is the engine who works well.
This is the pilot who flies the plane.
This is the pilot which flies the plane.
This is the engine whom works well.
expl: who 只能指人,which 只能指物。B 项先行词 the pilot 指人、用 who 且在从句中作主语,搭配正确;A、D 两项先行词 the engine 指物却用了 who / whom,C 项先行词指人却用了 which。
